sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Recommendation
sources.status: W3C Recommendation 12 December 2024; retrieved current latest-published URL
sources.supports: Normative criterion levels and distinction; no universal full-app conclusion from one case.

sources.title: Understanding SC 2.4.7 Focus Visible
sources.status: Informative W3C Understanding document; Level AA criterion
sources.supports: Visible indicator is distinct from merely visible component bounds.

sources.title: Understanding SC 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured Minimum
sources.status: Informative W3C Understanding document; Level AA criterion
sources.supports: Partial component visibility can satisfy minimum; focus indicator evaluated separately.

sources.title: Understanding SC 2.4.12 Focus Not Obscured Enhanced
sources.status: Informative W3C Understanding document; Level AAA criterion
sources.supports: No author-created obscuring of focused component; not a whole-app certification.

sources.title: APG Modal Dialog Pattern
sources.supports: Focus inside modal; initial focus depends on content; return on modal close.

sources.title: APG Introduction
sources.status: Explains APG is informative and examples illustrative
sources.supports: APG has no normative conformance model.

sources.title: APG Modal Dialog Example
sources.short_quote: The keyboard focus always remains visible.
sources.supports: Correct attribution of short quote; mobile background movement and AT-support considerations.

sources.title: WHATWG HTML focus method
sources.status: Living Standard; retrieved page last updated 17 November 2026
sources.supports: Step 4 invokes scrolling with auto/center/center when preventScroll=false; no partly-visible exemption in that step.

sources.title: CSSOM View scroll-target-into-view algorithm
sources.status: Editor's Draft 5 November 2026; work in progress, not final Recommendation
sources.supports: Ancestor scrolling boxes/viewport considered inner-to-outer; no inherently dialog-only offset guarantee.

sources.title: MDN HTMLElement.focus()
sources.status: API reference; corroboration, not browser acceptance
sources.supports: Default scrolling into view; focus indicator behavior is separately controlled.

sources.title: MDN Element.scrollIntoView()
sources.status: API reference; some options have varying support
sources.supports: Default scope includes all scrollable containers; explicit call is not intrinsically document-preserving.
